原子事实或待判断文本: California generally has warmer and more consistent weather than New York.
证据标题: California - State Climate Summaries 2022; New York - State Climate Summaries 2022
最小必要修正: California is often warmer, especially along the coast and in southern/desert areas, but its climate varies greatly by region; New York has more pronounced seasonal changes, with colder winters.
不确定性说明: “more consistent”若指沿海加州相对温和，有依据；若指全州，则因山地、沙漠、海岸差异而过度概括。

原子事实或待判断文本: California has milder winters and hot summers with little to no rainfall.
证据标题: Current Conditions - California Department of Water Resources; California - State Climate Summaries 2022
最小必要修正: Much of California has warm, dry summers and mild, wetter winters, but conditions vary by region; coastal areas can be mild, deserts very hot, and higher elevations cold and snowy.
不确定性说明: “little to no rainfall”更适合描述夏季，而非全年；“hot summers”和“milder winters”不适用于所有加州地区。

原子事实或待判断文本: New York experiences colder winters with snow and rain.
证据标题: Temperature - New York State Climate Impacts Assessment; New York - State Climate Summaries 2022
不确定性说明: 纽约州内部沿海、湖区和北部差异明显；该判断为州级一般描述。

原子事实或待判断文本: New York experiences warmer summers with higher humidity.
证据标题: Temperature - New York State Climate Impacts Assessment; Northeast - Fourth National Climate Assessment; New York - State Climate Summaries 2022
不确定性说明: “compared to California”下的湿度比较会随具体城市和季节变化；作为纽约/东北夏季一般特征有依据。
